faq_heading: Homes near Green Timbers Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Green Timbers Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Green Timbers Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It matches the school’s name in the listing text. A home near Green Timbers Elementary whose listing doesn’t mention it won’t appear.

faq.q: How much do homes near Green Timbers Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 39 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,215,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Green Timbers Elementary?
faq.a: Near Green Timbers Elementary (1 km), homes took a median 22 days to sell and closed at 95.3% of the list price, with 5% over asking, across 39 sales.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Green Timbers Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Brookside Elementary (0.7 km south-west), Enver Creek Secondary (0.9 km south) and Education Services (Alternate) (1.0 km north-west).

How the Green Timbers Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Green Timbers Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Green Timbers Elementary

29 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Green Timbers Elementary in a straight line (18 elementary, 9 secondary, 2 other; 2 independent). The closest is Brookside Elementary, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Woodland Park Elementary, 2.8 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Enver Creek Secondary (0.9 km); the nearest independent school is Cornerstone Montessori School (1.1 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Simon Cunningham Elementary (1.3 km). Other elementary schools close by: Brookside Elementary (0.7 km south-west), Cornerstone Montessori School (1.1 km south-east), Maple Green Elementary (1.2 km south-east), Janice Churchill Elementary (1.3 km south), Creekside Elementary (1.3 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Brookside Elementary, 0.7 km south-west of Green Timbers Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Green Timbers Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Green Timbers Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Green Timbers Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of Green Timbers Elementary was $1,215,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Brookside Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.7 km south-west of Green Timbers Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
